description.text:
The first XY Trainer Kit, released on 12 March 2014, held two 30-card half decks, Sylveon and Noivern, with a deck box, a rule book, counters, a coin showing the Kalos first partner Pokémon, a playmat and a Trainer Kit Guide for each half deck. It was the first kit without a booster pack, and the first since the EX Series whose featured cards were not reprints but its own. The cards carry the kit's own set symbol and number and no rarity mark. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the kit's code unlocked the two halves combined as the Mindbind theme deck.

The Sylveon half deck runs on Fairy Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: XY Trainer Kit (TCG) (Wayback Machine copy, 10 July 2026)
